---
'purrfold': minor
---

Make generated CI/CD pipelines optional behind `--ci`, and modernize them.

**Behavior change:** `.github/workflows/` is no longer generated by default.
`quality.yml` used to be written unconditionally — it was the CLI's only ungated
side effect on `.github/`. Pass `--ci` to get it back; `playwright.yml` still
requires `--e2e` on top of `--ci`. Existing generated apps are untouched.

The emitted workflows were also rebuilt around what real purrfold-generated
projects had to hand-fix:

- Action tags now come from `src/versions.json` (`actions` key) instead of being
  inlined in the template, and Renovate has a custom manager over them. Inlined
  tags are why generated pipelines rotted: nothing watched them, so every app
  kept running `actions/checkout@v4` and `actions/setup-node@v4` on the
  deprecated node20 runner. Both are now on v7.
- `push` is scoped to `main`. The previous `'**'` filter ran the job twice for
  every push to a branch with an open PR, with byte-identical results.
- Added `concurrency` with `cancel-in-progress`, job `timeout-minutes`, and
  workflow-level `permissions: contents: read`.
- `playwright.yml` runs chromium only, caches browser binaries keyed by the
  installed `@playwright/test` version, and drops report retention from 30 days
  to 7. The full firefox/webkit matrix stays on the local `test:e2e` script.
- Generated pnpm projects now get a `packageManager` field pinned to the exact
  pnpm that produced the lockfile, and the workflow's pnpm setup step drops its
  `version:` input and reads that field instead. This replaces `version: latest`,
  which let a pnpm major land in CI without a commit to point at when it broke.
  npm and bun are unaffected: npm ships with Node and bun is not
  corepack-managed, so neither has the local/CI drift this solves.
